  WHY: Every reviewer prompt would silently lose the "=== UNATTENDED SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS ===" block and the overflow pointer. Suggested fix: after the write, assert the copy starts with the instructions header and fail the step otherwise (about 4 lines).
